# NZ Herald
> New Zealand news site covering breaking news, analysis, opinion, business, sport, entertainment, travel, and lifestyle.

NZ Herald is a major New Zealand digital news publication with broad coverage of national and international events, live updates, premium journalism, video, podcasts, and magazine-style lifestyle content.

## Core News
- [Homepage](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/): Main entry point for breaking news, top stories, analysis, and featured coverage.
- [Latest News](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/latest-news/): Rolling feed of the newest stories across news, business, sport, and entertainment.
- [New Zealand News](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/): National news coverage including politics, crime, courts, and major local developments.
- [World News](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/): International news, geopolitics, conflicts, disasters, and global affairs reporting.
- [Opinion](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/opinion/): Columns, editorials, commentary, and analysis from NZ Herald writers and contributors.
- [Weather](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/weather/): Forecasts, severe weather coverage, and weather-related news updates.

## New Zealand & Local
- [Politics](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/politics/): Coverage of government, parliament, parties, elections, and public policy in New Zealand.
- [Crime](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/crime/): Reporting on police investigations, court cases, sentencing, and public safety issues.
- [Auckland](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/auckland/): Local news, transport, development, and community stories from Auckland.
- [Wellington](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/wellington/): Wellington news covering local government, transport, and regional events.
- [South Island](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/region/south-island/): Regional reporting and stories from communities across the South Island.
- [Northland](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/northland-age/news/): News and regional reporting from Northland and surrounding communities.

## Business & Money
- [Business](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/): Business news, company reporting, markets, economy, and commercial analysis.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/personal-finance/): Consumer money advice, savings, mortgages, retirement, and household finance coverage.
- [Property](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/property/): Residential and commercial property news, housing trends, and real estate analysis.
- [Small Business](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/small-business/): News and advice for entrepreneurs, operators, and growing businesses.
- [Economy](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/economy/): Economic indicators, policy impacts, inflation, and macroeconomic reporting.
- [Markets](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/markets/): Sharemarket, investment, and financial market coverage for New Zealand audiences.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/): Comprehensive sports coverage including results, analysis, and major event reporting.
- [Rugby](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/rugby/): Rugby union news, Super Rugby, internationals, and domestic competition coverage.
- [All Blacks](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/topic/all-blacks/): Dedicated coverage of the All Blacks, squads, matches, and commentary.
- [League](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/league/): Rugby league news including NRL, Warriors, and international league coverage.
- [Cricket](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/cricket/): Cricket news, match reports, player updates, and tournament coverage.
- [Football](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/football/): Football coverage spanning local leagues, international competitions, and major tournaments.

## Entertainment & Culture
- [Entertainment](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/entertainment/): Celebrity, television, film, music, and pop culture news and features.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/lifestyle/): Lifestyle reporting on health, relationships, home, style, and everyday living.
- [Travel](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/travel/): Destination ideas, travel advice, airline news, and holiday inspiration.
- [Canvas](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/canvas/): Features and long-form magazine content on culture, people, and ideas.
- [Viva](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/viva/): Fashion, beauty, food, design, and culture coverage from Viva.
- [The Listener](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/the-listener/): New Zealand Listener stories, commentary, reviews, and feature journalism.

## Multimedia
- [Video](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/video/): Video hub for news clips, interviews, explainers, and visual reporting.
- [Podcasts](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/podcasts/): Podcast directory featuring news, business, sport, and lifestyle audio series.
- [Live](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/live/): Live blogs and rolling coverage for major breaking news and sports events.
- [Photos](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/photos/): Photo galleries covering news events, sport, entertainment, and features.

## Premium & Subscriptions
- [Premium](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/premium/): Subscriber-only journalism, investigations, analysis, and exclusive feature reporting.
- [Subscribe](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/subscribe/): Subscription plans and access options for NZ Herald digital products.
- [Premium Business](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/): Business section frequently featuring premium analysis and subscriber reporting.
- [The Listener Premium](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/the-listener/): Magazine content and feature journalism available within the NZ Herald ecosystem.

## Topics & Special Coverage
- [New Zealand Politics Topic](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/topic/nz-politics/): Topic page aggregating political stories, analysis, and key developments.
- [Christopher Luxon Topic](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/topic/christopher-luxon/): Coverage and commentary related to Christopher Luxon.
- [Chris Hipkins Topic](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/topic/chris-hipkins/): Aggregated reporting and analysis on Chris Hipkins.
- [Nicola Willis Topic](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/topic/nicola-willis/): Topic page for stories involving Nicola Willis and related policy issues.
- [Israel-Hamas War Topic](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/topic/israel-hamas-war/): Ongoing coverage and updates on the conflict and international response.
- [Ukraine War Topic](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/topic/ukraine-war/): Reporting and analysis on the war in Ukraine and global implications.

## Utility
- [Search](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/search/): Site search for articles, topics, authors, and archived coverage.
- [Newsletters](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/newsletters/): Email newsletter signup pages for curated NZ Herald updates.
- [Contact Us](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/contact-us/): Contact information and newsroom or corporate contact pathways.
- [About Us](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/about-us/): Background information about NZ Herald and its publishing organization.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/terms-and-conditions/): Legal terms governing use of the website and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices, data handling, and user rights information.
